result.title: The Expressive Power of Random-Feature MPNNs Across Graph Sizes
result.summary: Continuous random node features increase the expressivity of message-passing neural networks (MPNNs), but existing theoretical analyses are not fine-grained enough to capture their limitations, particularly in approximating functions across graph sizes or under a fixed number of random bits. We develop a population-level framework for size-uniform approximation. For MPNNs with a graph-size-independent Lipschitz bound in their initial features, including standard mean, max, and order-normalized sum architectures, we show that continuous random features can be quantized to finitely many colors with arbitrarily small uniform error in expected output. This reduction lets us transfer limitations on finite-color distinguishability to limitations on size-uniform approximation with continuous random features. We use this framework to prove that these MPNNs are not size-uniformly universal, analyze the expressivity gains from colors and independent trials, and establish incomparability between random-color MPNNs and higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman methods. We also give finite-color MPNN constructions for tree subgraph isomorphism via color coding and a local MST task.

AI.brief_summary: 该文建立「跨图规模一致近似」的总体层面分析框架，证明对初始特征 Lipschitz 界不随规模增长的 MPNN（均值、最大值、序归一化和等），连续随机特征可量化为有限颜色且期望输出误差任意小，据此把有限颜色可区分性限制迁移为随机特征 MPNN 的一致近似限制，得出其非规模一致通用性、颜色与独立试验的增益，以及与高阶 WL 方法的不可比性。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯图论表达力研究，与视觉推理无直接关系；但其「连续随机特征可压缩为有限离散颜色且误差可控」的量化论证，以及固定随机比特下表达力上界与规模一致近似的刻画，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态容量受限、离散瓶颈与长度/规模泛化之间的类比，属推测性线索。
